name: usage-monitor
description: Live Claude plan usage (5-hour session, weekly limits, extra usage), context window and session cost in a panel and a band above the prompt.

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often the account usage is fetched. Minimum 30.

showBand.title: Show the band above the prompt
showBand.description: A one-line usage summary right above the message box.

openPanelOnStart.title: Open the panel when a session starts
openPanelOnStart.description: Opens the usage panel (as a widget in the desktop app). The terminal opens it only with the command.

showStatusLine.title: Show usage in the status line
showStatusLine.description: Adds a short usage entry to the status line.

alertThresholds.title: Alert thresholds (%)
alertThresholds.description: Comma-separated percentages that raise a toast once per window, e.g. 80,95. Empty turns alerts off.

desktopNotifications.title: System notification at the highest threshold
desktopNotifications.description: Also raises a native notification when the highest threshold is crossed.
